cooling_off_until.description: Until when your account cools off: approving, releasing payments, changing bank details, roles or sign-ins, break-glass and confirming others' recoveries wait until then.

recovery_codes.description: Ten recovery codes, each usable once. They are shown once: print them or keep them in a password manager. With an Owner's or Administrator's confirmation, one gives your account back if you lose every authenticator (SEC-35). Your earlier unused codes no longer work.

items.description: A recovery code, usable once: 10 characters.
